```{r}
# Required libraries
library(devtools)  # For GitHub packages
library(readr)     # CSV handling
library(gt)        # Table formatting
library(xml2)      # XML/KML processing
library(rlang)     # For the %||% operator

# Suppress CSV column type messages
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)

#' Convert common color names to ABGR format used in KML
#' @param color_name A string containing the color name
#' @return ABGR color code as string
get_abgr_color <- function(color_name) {
  color_map <- list(
    "red"    = "ff0000ff",
    "blue"   = "ffff0000",
    "green"  = "ff00ff00",
    "yellow" = "ff00ffff",
    "purple" = "ffff00ff",
    "white"  = "ffffffff",
    "black"  = "ff000000",
    "orange" = "ff0080ff",
    "pink"   = "ffff00ff",
    "gray"   = "ff808080"
  )
  
  return(color_map[[tolower(color_name)]])
}

#' Generate Google Maps icon URL based on color and symbol type
#' @param color Color name for the icon
#' @param symbol_type Either "pushpin" or "paddle"
#' @return Complete URL for the icon
get_icon_url <- function(color, symbol_type) {
  # Define color mappings for different symbol types
  symbol_colors <- list(
    pushpin = list(
      "white" = "wht",
      "blue"  = "blue",
      "green" = "grn",
      "yellow" = "ylw",
      "purple" = "purple",
      "lightblue" = "ltblu",
      "pink" = "pink",
      "red" = "red"
    ),
    paddle = list(
      "white" = "wht",
      "blue" = "blu",
      "lightblue" = "ltblu",
      "green" = "grn",
      "yellow" = "ylw",
      "purple" = "purple",
      "orange" = "org",
      "pink" = "pink",
      "red" = "red"
    )
  )
  
  # Select appropriate color mapping
  color_map <- if (tolower(symbol_type) == "paddle") {
    symbol_colors$paddle
  } else {
    symbol_colors$pushpin
  }
  
  # Get color code or default to red
  color_code <- color_map[[tolower(color)]] %||% "red"
  
  # Build icon URL
  base_url <- "http://maps.google.com/mapfiles/kml/"
  if (tolower(symbol_type) == "paddle") {
    return(paste0(base_url, "paddle/", color_code, "-circle.png"))
  } else {
    return(paste0(base_url, "pushpin/", color_code, "-pushpin.png"))
  }
}

#' Create a KML file from location data
#' @param data Dataframe containing location data
#' @param output_file Output KML filename
#' @return None, writes KML file to disk
create_kml <- function(data, output_file = "locations.kml") {
  # Set default styling values if not provided
  default_styles <- list(
    symbol = "pushpin",
    symbol_scale = 1.2,
    text_color = "white",
    text_scale = 1.0,
    color = "red"
  )
  
  # Apply defaults where missing
  for (style in names(default_styles)) {
    if (!style %in% names(data)) {
      data[[style]] <- default_styles[[style]]
    }
  }
  
  # Create KML document structure
  kml <- xml_new_root("kml", xmlns = "http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2")
  doc <- xml_add_child(kml, "Document")
  
  # Generate unique styles
  styles <- create_styles(data, doc)
  
  # Add placemarks
  add_placemarks(data, doc, styles)
  
  # Write KML file
  xml2::write_xml(kml, output_file)
  message("KML file created successfully: ", output_file)
}

#' Create styles for KML markers
#' @param data Dataframe with style information
#' @param doc XML document node
#' @return List mapping style keys to style IDs
create_styles <- function(data, doc) {
  style_map <- list()
  style_counter <- 1
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    style_key <- paste(
      data$color[i],
      data$symbol[i],
      data$symbol_scale[i],
      data$text_color[i],
      data$text_scale[i],
      sep = "_"
    )
    
    if (!style_key %in% names(style_map)) {
      style_id <- paste0("style", style_counter)
      style_map[[style_key]] <- style_id
      style_counter <- style_counter + 1
      
      add_style_to_doc(doc, style_id, data[i, ])
    }
  }
  
  return(style_map)
}

#' Add a style definition to the KML document
#' @param doc XML document node
#' @param style_id Style identifier
#' @param style_data Single row of data with style information
add_style_to_doc <- function(doc, style_id, style_data) {
  style <- xml_add_child(doc, "Style", id = style_id)
  
  # Icon style
  icon_style <- xml_add_child(style, "IconStyle")
  xml_add_child(icon_style, "scale", as.character(style_data$symbol_scale))
  icon <- xml_add_child(icon_style, "Icon")
  xml_add_child(icon, "href", 
                get_icon_url(style_data$color, style_data$symbol))
  
  # Label style
  label_style <- xml_add_child(style, "LabelStyle")
  xml_add_child(label_style, "scale", as.character(style_data$text_scale))
  xml_add_child(label_style, "color", get_abgr_color(style_data$text_color))
}

#' Add placemarks to the KML document
#' @param data Dataframe with location data
#' @param doc XML document node
#' @param styles Style mapping list
add_placemarks <- function(data, doc, styles) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(data))) {
    placemark <- xml_add_child(doc, "Placemark")
    xml_add_child(placemark, "name", data$place_name[i])
    
    # Add style reference
    style_key <- paste(
      data$color[i],
      data$symbol[i],
      data$symbol_scale[i],
      data$text_color[i],
      data$text_scale[i],
      sep = "_"
    )
    xml_add_child(placemark, "styleUrl", paste0("#", styles[[style_key]]))
    
    # Add description if available
    if ("description" %in% names(data)) {
      xml_add_child(placemark, "description", data$description[i])
    }
    
    # Add coordinates
    point <- xml_add_child(placemark, "Point")
    coords <- sprintf("%f,%f,0", data$longitude[i], data$latitude[i])
    xml_add_child(point, "coordinates", coords)
  }
}

# Example usage:
locations <- data.frame(
  place_name = c("New York City", "Paris", "Sydney"),
  latitude = c(40.7484, 48.8584, -33.8568),
  longitude = c(-73.9857, 2.2945, 151.2153),
  description = c("Empire State Bldg", "Eiffel Tower", "Opera House"),
  color = c("yellow", "green", "lightblue"),
  symbol = c("pushpin", "paddle", "paddle"),
  symbol_scale = c(1.2, 1.5, 1.0),
  text_color = c("Yellow", "Green", "Orange"),
  text_scale = c(1.0, 1.2, 0.8)
)
```
